verdict.rationale: Jan ships a built-in OpenAI-compatible local API server (jan-docs-6, jan-gh-4/13) explicitly marketed as a 'drop-in replacement for cloud APIs,' which lets developers call it using existing OpenAI Python/JS SDKs by pointing the base URL to localhost:1337. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated, officially branded Jan client library for Python or JavaScript — only OpenAI-API compatibility is documented. Missing for 10: an official Jan-branded SDK/package, published API reference (openapi probes 404), and independent developer confirmation of using client libraries against the server.
